info.title: Kraken Spot WebSocket API
info.description:
Stream live cryptocurrency market data over a single WebSocket connection: order books, tickers, trades and candles for every listed pair, pushed the moment they change.

### Highlights

- ⚡ **Real time.** Updates are pushed as trades happen, so there is nothing to poll.
- 🔓 **No API key.** Every market data channel is public. Open a socket and start subscribing.
- 📚 **Level 2 order book.** Up to 1,000 price levels per side, with a CRC32 checksum to verify your local copy.
- 🕯️ **Candles.** OHLC in nine intervals, from one minute to fifteen days.
- 🔁 **Request correlation.** Every request can carry a `req_id`, which the server echoes on its response.

### Quick start

1. Open a connection to `wss://ws.kraken.com/v2`.
2. Send a `subscribe` request naming a channel and the pairs you want.
3. Read the acknowledgement, then a `snapshot` of the current state, then a stream of `update` messages.

```json
{ "method": "subscribe", "params": { "channel": "ticker", "symbol": ["BTC/USD"] }, "req_id": 1 }
```

### Channels

| Channel | Streams | Extra parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticker` | Best bid and ask, last price, 24-hour statistics | `event_trigger` |
| `book` | Level 2 order book | `depth` |
| `ohlc` | Open, high, low, close candles | `interval` |
| `trade` | Every executed trade | |
| `instrument` | Reference data for assets and pairs | |

> While you hold at least one subscription, the server sends a `heartbeat` about once a second whenever there is nothing else to send. If the stream goes quiet, the connection is gone.

production.title: Production
production.description: Public market data endpoint. No authentication required: connect and start subscribing.

marketData.title: Market data
marketData.summary: The single socket every request and update travels over.
marketData.description:
Kraken multiplexes every feed over one connection. Requests carry a `method`; pushed updates carry a `channel` naming the feed they belong to, and a `type` of `snapshot` or `update`.

Which updates arrive depends entirely on what you have subscribed to, so a fresh connection receives nothing but its initial `status` message.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to a feed
subscribe.summary: Start streaming a channel for one or more currency pairs.
subscribe.description:
The server answers with one acknowledgement **per currency pair**, each carrying your `req_id`. On success the first update is a snapshot of the current state, unless you set `snapshot` to `false`.

Subscribing to a pair you already follow on the same channel is rejected with `Already subscribed`, so it is safe to retry.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from a feed
unsubscribe.summary: Stop streaming a channel for one or more currency pairs.
unsubscribe.description: Pass the same `channel` and `symbol` you subscribed with. Pairs you are not subscribed to come back with `success: false` and leave the rest of the request unaffected.

ping.title: Ping
ping.summary: Check the connection is alive. The server replies with a pong.
ping.description: Useful on a connection with no subscriptions, which receives no heartbeats. The `pong` echoes your `req_id` along with server-side receive and send times, so you can measure round-trip latency.

sendTicker.title: Ticker updates
sendTicker.summary: Best bid and ask, last price, and 24-hour statistics for each subscribed pair.
sendTicker.description: Published on every trade by default. Subscribe with `event_trigger: "bbo"` to be told about every change to the best bid or offer instead.

sendBook.title: Order book
sendBook.summary: Level 2 bids and asks, as a snapshot followed by incremental updates.
sendBook.description:
Apply each update to your local book: a level with `qty` of `0` is removed, any other value replaces the level at that price. Then trim the book back to your subscribed `depth`.

Every message carries a CRC32 `checksum` of the top ten levels. Recompute it after each update; a mismatch means your copy has drifted and you should resubscribe.

sendOhlc.title: Candles
sendOhlc.summary: Open, high, low and close prices for each interval, updated as trades land.
sendOhlc.description: The current candle is republished on every trade until its interval closes, so the last message for a given `interval_begin` is the final one.

sendTrade.title: Trade updates
sendTrade.summary: Every trade executed on each subscribed pair.
sendTrade.description: The snapshot holds the 50 most recent trades. After that, each update can batch several trades that executed together.

sendInstrument.title: Instruments
sendInstrument.summary: Every listed asset and currency pair, with precision and order size rules.
sendInstrument.description: Subscribe without a `symbol`: this channel always covers the whole exchange. Use it to validate order sizes and to format prices to the right number of decimals.

sendStatus.title: Connection status
sendStatus.summary: The exchange's status on connect, then a heartbeat about once a second while subscribed.
sendStatus.description: A `status` message arrives as soon as the connection opens, and again whenever the exchange's trading state changes, for example when it enters `maintenance`.

requestId.description: The client-chosen `req_id`, echoed on the server's response.

symbols.description: Currency pairs to subscribe to. Required for every channel except `instrument`.

reqId.title: Request id
reqId.description: Optional client-chosen id, echoed on the response.

price.description: A price in the quote currency.

quantity.description: A quantity in the base currency.

updateType.description: `snapshot` is the first message after subscribing and holds the full current state; `update` follows on each change.

time_in.description: When the server received the request.

time_out.description: When the server sent the response.

snapshot.description: Send the current state as the first update.

event_trigger.description: `ticker` only. Publish on every trade, or on every change to the best bid or offer.

depth.description: `book` only. Number of price levels to receive on each side.

interval.description: `ohlc` only. Candle length in minutes, from one minute to fifteen days.

depth.description: `book` only. The depth you subscribed with.

interval.description: `ohlc` only. The interval you subscribed with.

subscriptionResult.description: The subscription that was created or removed. Present when `success` is true.

subscriptionResponse.title: Subscribe response
subscriptionResponse.description: One acknowledgement per currency pair in the request.

error.description: Why the request failed. Present when `success` is false.

symbol.description: The pair that failed, when the failure is specific to one.

unsubscriptionResponse.title: Unsubscribe response
unsubscriptionResponse.description: One acknowledgement per currency pair in the request.

error.description: Why the request failed. Present when `success` is false.

symbol.description: The pair that failed, when the failure is specific to one.

volume.description: 24-hour traded volume, in the base currency.

change.description: 24-hour price change, in the quote currency.

qty.description: Total quantity at this price. `0` in an update means the level was removed.

checksum.description: CRC32 of the top ten bids and asks after this message is applied.

timestamp.description: When the book changed. Updates only.

open.description: First trade price in the interval.

high.description: Highest trade price in the interval.

low.description: Lowest trade price in the interval.

close.description: Last trade price in the interval so far.

trades.description: Number of trades in the interval.

volume.description: Traded volume in the interval, in the base currency.

vwap.description: Volume-weighted average price over the interval.

status.description: Whether the asset can currently be deposited, withdrawn or traded.

precision_display.description: Decimal places to show to users.

collateral_value.description: Fraction of value counted as margin collateral.

status.description: Which orders the pair currently accepts.

qty_precision.description: Decimal places allowed in an order quantity.

qty_min.description: Smallest order quantity, in the base currency.

price_precision.description: Decimal places allowed in a price.

cost_precision.description: Decimal places in an order's cost.

cost_min.description: Smallest order value, in the quote currency.

has_index.description: Has an index price, used for triggering stop orders.

connection_id.description: Identifies this connection. Quote it when contacting support.
